notes.title: Free web version now available! Thank you!
notes.notes:
PLAY THE WEB VERSION HERE!

Hello! It's been almost four years since this game came out. Anyone who played it, I want to extend my gratitude your way.

I made this game in 7th grade, when I was 13 years old. Obviously, it is not perfect. GameMaker's gone corporate. But I really did enjoy making it, even if I moved on rather quick. More importantly, I hope some of you enjoyed playing it. Thanks for the reviews!

I've been a game developer since birth. I love computers and the arts, and how they can weave beautifully together. Recently, I've stagnated in terms of execution, but I'll struggle to run out of ideas. As I finish up the bulkiest part of high school, I hope I can mend these regrets. I'm trying to improve my artistic and technical skills, so that, under my new pen-name Faxrabbit, I can share Short, Free/Cheap, & Queer little games--and, in the future, full-fledged productions.

Hopefully that website is populated in due time :-)

Since this game is old and bad, I've made it free as an HTML5 game at faxrabb.it. If you've bought it already, thank you for the support. It will still be priced on Steam--with many, many discounts--so new players can choose to support me financially.

Let me know if there's any bugs by emailing me at chase@faxrabb.it

You can also check out my personal website for other insane ramblings!

Thanks again!!
Chase
